{{Quote|Red Leader standing by.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
'''Red Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of Red Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign "Red Leader."

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
[[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]] flew as Red Leader with his [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Jedi starfighter squadron]],<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and led his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], including [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], into battle against the forces of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Merai]] at the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]].<ref name="Rep50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref>

A [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Red Leader (Muunilinst)|Red Leader]] commanded a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] at the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].<ref name="CW10">{{CW|10}}</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] flew the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Star Runner]]'' as "Red Leader", commanding a Delta-7 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in [[Rebellion on Felucia|pursuit]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] over [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], and in [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|defense]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Kinect" />

[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] flew an [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]] as Red Leader in the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]].<ref name="Rep77">[[Republic 77|''Republic'' 77]]</ref>

During the [[recapture of Tythe]] and the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] led Red Squadron, flying in his [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Jedi Interceptor]] along with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], as [[Red Five/Legends|Red Five]] and a squadron of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] led by Commander [[Davijaan/Legends|Davijaan]].

===Rebel Alliance===
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hamo Blastwell]] was Red Leader of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], leading [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] on [[Battle in the Turkana system|his first mission]].<ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]]<ref name="red1">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Red Leader}}</ref> served as Red Leader at the Alliance's [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], leading his pilots against the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during which Dreis was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] flew as Red Leader during a [[reconnaissance mission to Kamino]],<ref name="RFF">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref> an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ison Corridor ambush|ambush in the Ison Corridor]]<ref name="RS2">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref> and later, a [[skirmish at Chinshassa]].<ref name="SW60">[[Star Wars (1977) 60|''Star Wars'' (1977) 60]]</ref>

Approximately [[2 ABY/Legends|two years after the Battle of Yavin]], Lieutenant Commander [[Bakki Sourthol]] was Red Leader,<ref name="CSWE" /> commanding an X-wing squadron with [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]].<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] flew as Red Leader, commanding the squadron formerly known as [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. He led Red Squadron into the superstructure of the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]], and, along with [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], destroyed the battle station.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Following that battle, Red Squadron was once more renamed Rogue Squadron,<ref name="GG5">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]]</ref> although Antilles flew with the Rogues as Red Leader on [[Battle of Tandankin|at least one occasion]].<ref name="XWRSS" />

Shortly after the Alliance's victory at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], another Red Leader&mdash;the youngest of the Rebel squadron leaders of the [[Bakura task force]]&mdash;led an element of Red Squadron tasked with maintaining an escape cone for Rogue and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadrons]] during the [[Bakura/Legends|planet's]] [[Invasion of Bakura|invasion]] by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]], and later in the battle destroyed a Ssi-ruuvi [[Wurrif-class light cruiser|''Wurrif''-class light cruiser]].<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

===New Republic===
A [[Red Leader (Star Tours)|pilot]] designated "Red Leader"<ref name="ILM book" /> led the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Red Squadron (Star Tours)|Red Squadron]] [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the Battle of Endor,<ref name="CDD" /> rescuing a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency [[StarSpeeder 3000]] from an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer's]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], and defending the civilian vessel from [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] when it accidentally ended up in the midst of the squadron's [[Battle of Death Star III|battle]] to destroy a [[Death Star III|Death Star-like space station]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>

Commander [[Mirith Sinn]] flew a [[X-wing (tandem)|tandem X-wing starfighter]] as Red Leader in the [[Battle of Smarck]].<ref name="CE2" />

Wedge Antilles again flew as Red Leader in [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulated]] [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] training,<ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> and later with [[Red Flight]] on a New Republic mission to the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="XW:SoA" />

During the the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]] pilot [[Esege Tuketu]] led the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|New Republic Fifth Battle Group's]] [[Red Flight (K-wings)|Red Flight]] as Red Leader, with [[Skids]] as his [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="BTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] identifies Garven Dreis as [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]] and the film's [[Gold Six/Legends|Gold Leader]], [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]], as Red Leader.<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>
